catchable_launch_registration_window.finding: Popen construction precedes the cleanup try. A caught signal may raise after child creation but before assignment/registration; stdlib constructor cleanup closes fds but does not kill that new child.
catchable_launch_registration_window.resolution_requested: Defer raising handled signals through child launch/registration, then raise pending interruption inside owned cleanup try; cover signal-at-Popen-return.

root_bootstrap_startup_isolation_request.finding: Bootstrap helper and venv creation currently use no enforced -I-S launch; -I alone can execute shared sitecustomize before helper's clean environment takes effect.
root_bootstrap_startup_isolation_request.resolution_requested: Require helper bootstrap -I-S flags and create venv with -I-S; fresh venv pip/metadata use -I. Root will use -I-S for actual launch.
